div.head: Iud Dei XIII 10.1
div.ab: Adiuro te, aqua, in nomine — — obicitur = I 21—21, 4, s. o. S. 404. Et si non est culpabilis, tibi omnimodis subiciatur.

div.ab: I adjure you, water, in the name — — is charged = I 21–21, 4, see above p. 404. And if he is not guilty, let him be put beneath you in every way.
